blocks.what_we_do: Write a clear summary of the whole simulated main path. Save the final results and figures so that others can check them.
blocks.why:
A report must link the study design, the QC decisions, the model, the effect sizes, the uncertainty and the figures. Include the genome build, the software versions, the numbers of samples, the exclusions, the PCs, the tested allele and the threshold. Report the [odds ratio](docs/glossary.md#or) and its 95% [confidence interval](docs/glossary.md#ci) for each lead variant. The interval shows how uncertain the estimate is.

Keep two differences clear. An association that we observed is not a proof of a cause. A signal that we simulated for teaching is not a biological discovery. A result that is not significant can come from low [statistical power](docs/glossary.md#statistical-power), which is the chance to detect an effect of a given size in this study. Keep a record that others can repeat, but do not publish data about single people.
blocks.you_need: Modules 0 to 6, checked. Also the summary statistics file from step 6.8 and the figures and comparisons from steps 7.1 to 7.7.
blocks.command:
```{r s7-8}
psam <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.7"), ".psam"))
comparison <- read.delim(guided_path(cfg, "7.7", "comparison.tsv"))
clumps <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "7.5", "clump"), ".clumps"))
stats <- guided_summary_stats(cfg)
lead <- stats[match(clumps$ID, stats$variant_id), c("chromosome", "base_pair_location", "variant_id", "effect_allele", "odds_ratio", "beta", "standard_error", "p_value", "n")]
lead$ci_low <- exp(lead$beta - 1.96 * lead$standard_error)
lead$ci_high <- exp(lead$beta + 1.96 * lead$standard_error)
guided_write(lead, guided_path(cfg, "7.8", "leads.tsv"))
summary <- c("# Simulated GWAS: main-path summary", "", "Genome assembly: GRCh38. Simulated data, seed 20261111.",
  paste("Software:", paste(cfg$version, collapse = "; ")),
  "Initial: 2,016 measured wells, 2,000 people, 299,523 variant entries.",
  paste("Final cohort:", nrow(psam), "samples; cases:", sum(psam$Disease == "2"), "; controls:", sum(psam$Disease == "1")),
  "After QC: 238,513 variants; 236,815 finite additive association tests.",
  "Model: additive logistic regression, adjusted for age, recorded sex and ten within-cohort PCs; Firth fallback enabled.",
  "Eight variants pass p < 5e-8 in three LD clumps. Autosomal lambda is approximately 1.016.",
  "Report the effect allele, odds ratio, 95% interval, p-value and per-variant sample count n from s7-8_leads.tsv.",
  "Interpretation: the three strong simulated regions are recovered; the moderate region is subthreshold. No causal gene is established.",
  "Sensitivity: omitting PCs increases lambda to approximately 1.546; omitting sample/variant QC as well gives approximately 1.655.",
  "Limitations: simulated design, selected array sites, finite power, provisional imported REF labels, study-specific QC and ancestry rules.",
  "Three named ancestry markers left at HWE step 4.4; comparisons must not pretend they survived to module 5.",
  "Figures: s7-1_qq.png, s7-3_manhattan.png, s7-6_regional.png and s7-7_qq_comparison.png.",
  "No biological discovery or clinical recommendation follows from this simulation.")
writeLines(summary, guided_path(cfg, "7.8", "summary.md"), useBytes = TRUE)
files <- c(guided_path(cfg, "7.8", "summary.md"), guided_path(cfg, "7.8", "leads.tsv"),
  guided_path(cfg, "7.1", "qq.png"), guided_path(cfg, "7.3", "manhattan.png"),
  guided_path(cfg, "7.6", "regional.png"), guided_path(cfg, "7.7", "qq_comparison.png"),
  guided_path(cfg, "7.7", "comparison.tsv"), paste0(guided_path(cfg, "7.5", "clump"), ".clumps"),
  file.path(cfg$out, "step_counts.tsv"), file.path(cfg$out, "software_versions.txt"))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "7.8", files, parent = "6.8")
check_step("7.8", data_dir = cfg$out, work_dir = cfg$out)
cat(paste(summary, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: this step needs no PLINK command. The R chunk is the complete command.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
A final summary, three rows for the lead variants with alleles, odds ratios and intervals, and all main figures. The 7.8 checkpoint manifest protects these files. The main path ends here. Imputation, mixed models and the analysis after a GWAS are not part of it.

The tested PLINK version is set in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: the executable chunks, the comparisons with the expected results and the final plot checks passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the input file that R names and the previous step. Keep the command and the messages from the console. Do not use files from a different version of the dataset. See [troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
What more evidence would we need before we call a simulated association a biological discovery?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

We would need real data that are handled under proper rules, [replication](docs/glossary.md#replication) in independent data and suitable biological evidence. This simulation gives none of these.

</details>

figures.gemini_prompt: Create a labelled teaching schematic for Final summary and reporting. Use shapes and text as well as colour. Do not invent numeric course results, gene annotations or individual identities. This complements the tested R plot; it does not replace it.
figures.alt_text: Teaching schematic: Final summary and reporting.
